messages:
lina (People Ops): thanks for the great q's during the all-hands. opening this thread for follow-ups on leveling, comp bands, off-cycle promos, equity vesting questions, and international payroll notes. i'll capture answers and next steps here. quick: calibration closes Friday 11:59pm PT, final emails Mon.

meera (Eng): two quick ones: 1) if someone is mid-notice, are they eligible for off-cycle promo? 2) can we move vesting dates for retention offers?

rafael (Head of People): 1) generally promos not awarded during notice unless there's a compelling business case and documented manager+manager-up signoff. submit via Off-cycle Promo form and tag me for fast-track.

nina (Total Rewards): 2) on vesting schedule changes: we can make exceptions for negotiated retention offers (e.g., extend cliff or accelerate grants) but need legal + finance sign-off. submit a Compensation Exception request with proposed schedule and business rationale.

tyler (Manager): curious about leveling evidence standards  what differentiates a strong vs borderline case? managers want concrete examples to collect.

lina (People Ops): good ask  we published a short Leveling Evidence checklist (1-page) to help managers. link: https://redwood.internal/people-docs/leveling-evidence-checklist. top tips: cite measured outcomes, cross-team impact, and sustained scope over 6+ months. include peer feedback where possible.

sam (SWE): international payroll hiccups: i had a new hire in EMEA who saw delayed retro pay last cycle. any process change?

payroll-bot: FYI: payroll cutoff for EMEA is earlier (three business days before US)  cases submitted after cutoff go into next run. For retro pay, allow 2-3 cycles for cross-border.

nina (Total Rewards): adding: for contractors -> employee conversions, submit the payroll ticket + comp approval early; otherwise tax reconciliation can delay retro by another cycle.

meera (Eng): how will open req ranges be affected after bands finalize? recruiters need to know today.

lina (People Ops): bands lock after calibration. recruiting can proceed with last-approved ranges but must re-request approval if offer exceeds the new finalized top of band. recruiters: use the Recruiter Pre-Approval form for any hires above midpoint.

tyler (Manager): appeals workflow? we had an IC wanting a second review.

lina (People Ops): appeals accepted within 10 business days. procedure: manager + IC submit Appeal form with new evidence. Appeals panel = People + 2 neutral managers + 1 director-level reviewer. outcomes: uphold / adjust / escalate to exec review.

rafael (Head of People): transparency note: we will publish anonymized stats post-cycle (counts by band movement and by org) so folks can see trends.

sam (SWE): can HR join a short manager forum next week to go over edge cases?

lina (People Ops): yes  scheduling poll posted in #people-ops in ~10m. i can do two 45m slots next Tue.

nina (Total Rewards): FYI on equity: RSU grant cadence unchanged this year. for newly approved promotions that close after the grant window there will be a "mid-cycle grant" process; well share the timelines in the grants doc.

meera (Eng): question on salary compression  we have a new hire higher than an existing IC, what's the guidance?

lina (People Ops): avoid compression where possible. options: 1) promote or market-adjust the tenured IC, 2) make the candidate offer contingent on different comp structure, or 3) provide a spot adjustment. talk to your People Partner early and include comp rationale.

payroll-bot: Reminder: Calibration survey closes Friday 23:59 PT. Please complete if you participated. :bell:

rafael (Head of People): action items: Lina to post the Leveling Evidence checklist and Calibration FAQ by EOD Thu; Nina to publish equity mid-cycle grant timeline; People Ops to run two manager office hours next Tue; Payroll to update international cutoff note in the payroll KB.

lina (People Ops): thanks all  closing thread for now. if you need 1:1 follow-up, DM me or open a People Ops ticket (https://redwood.internal/people-portal/tickets).
